title: gui: Diagrams tabs — Types (class/type diagram) + Modules (crate DAG)
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W3]
Seats: GRAPH-03, GRAPH-04
crates/gui/src/diagrams/{types,modules}.rs using the GRAPH-2 common kit: types.rs renders TypeNode/TypeEdge with fields (+types), methods, and Field/Impl/Inherit/Variant edges at file|module|repo scope with a scope switcher and real names; modules.rs renders ModuleNode/ModuleEdge (Crate/Dir/Module/File) as a layered DAG with import counts on edges and cycle highlighting. Both click-through to source. Depends: GRAPH-2 (kit) + CORE-4/CORE-5 (data). Owner: crates/gui/src/diagrams/{types,modules}.rs. Verify: cargo build/clippy/test -p repowalk-gui; report a screenshot-free structural check (node/edge counts shown in the UI vs analysis.json counts).

EVIDENCE:
Files: crates/gui/src/diagrams/types.rs and crates/gui/src/diagrams/modules.rs (only these two files touched; 5 inline tests each).

types.rs (Diagrams -> Types): one box per Analysis.types entry (name + kind badge; fields as `name: type`; methods as `name()`), grouped by module_path (fallback: file dir) and tinted with theme::module_color. Edges styled distinctly by kind: Inherit solid ACCENT, Impl dashed INFO, Field solid thin + label, Variant dashed WARNING + label; arrowheads show `from -> to`. Selecting a type (app.selection) brightens its box + direct neighbours and dims the rest; clicking a box calls app.select(Selection::Symbol(id)) using the index symbol id (file:line) when one matches so it click-throughs to source, else the type id. Empty state: no analysis -> "press Learn"; analysis with 0 types names card CORE-5. Cap: NODE_CAP=200 boxes, header states the cap; layout is a pure fn of (types, columns) and is unit-tested for determinism.

modules.rs (Diagrams -> Modules): crate -> dir -> module -> file depth layers built from Submodule edges (BFS, deterministic); each node shows id, kind badge, `loc loc . sym symbols`. Submodule edges are faint tree lines; Import edges are labelled with their aggregated `count` (xN) and coloured INFO. Cycles from core modules::cycles are marked: member nodes ringed DANGER + a glyph, intra-cycle import edges DANGER, header shows cycle count with a hover listing the members. Clicking a File node opens it via app.select(Selection::File(path)). Empty state names card CORE-9 (the pipeline card). Caps: NODE_CAP=250 nodes, EDGE_CAP=400 imports, stated in the header.

Honesty: analysis.modules is NOT populated in the checked-in .repowalk/analysis.json (stale: modules=0, module_edges=0, types=118, type_edges=148) so the Modules tab shows the CORE-9 empty state on the current artifact. CORE-9 HAS landed in code: crates/core/src/learn.rs:206-208 calls modules::build and stores into analysis.modules/module_edges, so a fresh Learn fills it. No per-frame deep clones: only app.analysis Arc is cloned; all lookups borrow. No panics (indexing guarded, division-free, cycle walk guarded). No new deps.
